reasoning_content: The issue is that tick-generator is importing from '../../shared/types' but the actual file is likely at a different path. Let me fix the imports to point to the correct location. Also need to add missing methods to managers.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project/wasd-clone && 

# Fix tick-generator import
sed -i "s|'../../shared/types'|'./shared/types'|g" server/src/tick-generator.ts

# Fix LegendPropagationystem imports (need static methods)
sed -i "s/NPCManager.getAllNPCs()/NPCManager.instance.getAllNPCs()/g" server/src/systems/LegendPropagationSystem.ts
sed -i "s/LegendManager.getGlobalLegends()/LegendManager.instance.getGlobalLegends()/g" server/src/systems/LegendPropagationSystem.ts
sed -i "s/FactionManager.createFaction/FactionManager.instance.createFaction/g" server/src/systems/LegendPropagationSystem.ts

echo "Fixed imports"
